sloka: शोषणम् दारणम् चैव वज्रम् अस्त्रम् सुदुर्जयम् ।ब्रह्म पाशम् काल पाशम् वारुणम् पाशम् एव च ॥१-५६-८॥
transliteration: śoṣaṇam dāraṇam caiva vajram astram sudurjayam ।brahma pāśam kāla pāśam vāruṇam pāśam eva ca ॥1-56-8॥

translations.english: "O Descendent of Raghu Viswamitra employed weapons like manava, mohana, gandharva, swapana, jrimbhana, madana, santapana, vilapana, shoshana, darana, vajra weapons, Brahma, kala and varuna pasas, the favourite painaka, daita, shushka, ardra vajras, danda, paisacha, krauncha, weapons, dharmachakra, kalachakra, vishnuchakras, vayavya, mathana, hayasira weapons, kanakala, musala powers, vaidyadhara, kalatrishula, kapala, kankana weapons discharged against Vasishta the best of ascetics. All this became aweful.
translations.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्‌ ! आपने पूज्य होकर भी मेरा अच्छा सत्कार किया । छ वाक्यविशारद ! अब मैं कहता हूँ, उसे आप सुनें
